name: application-pagination
title: Pagination
description: Responsive pagination components for page navigation in web applications, dashboards, and data tables with numbered links and previous/next buttons.
useWhen: Responsive pagination components for page navigation in web applications, dashboards, and data tables with numbered links and previous/next buttons.
avoidWhen: Avoid pagination when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Pagination uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Associate each form field with a visible or programmatic label before production use.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
